title: Layers in the metadata
prompt: A photo's metadata has one field that looks like random digits. Peel it layer by layer.
hint.1: Only UserComment is unusual. It uses only 0-9 and a-f.
hint.2: Decode it as hex first. The result is not the flag yet.
hint.3: The decoded text ends with = signs: that is Base64. Decode it again.
walkthrough: Hex-decode UserComment, then Base64-decode the result.
